narrative: On the part. A part-roll on a trestle at the Theatre, the name at the head. The margin beside the first speech is blank. No new line is written. On the part. The same roll. The blank margin. The pen is not in the frame.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Read the part and did not write on it.

entities.name: Love's Labour's Lost
entities.context: Shown on part in Navarre, and no new line
